message.reasoning_content: Take influence for presidency and law veto power. Bribe 5 to idx0 gives influence 2, tying... president is highest influence + tie_order; idx1 has 1. With 2 I'd become president? Influence 2 > 1, yes. That grants veto and 5% bonus. Bribe 5 to 0 (not current president) or to 1 — giving to 0 strengthens a rival; giving to 1 gives president more cash. Either way. Better to bribe idx0? They have 17. Bribe 1 gives them 22. Hmm, either. Choose choice 4 (5 to 0) — get presidency cheaply.
